title: Peer release-vs-branch provenance and recent silent-loss report audit
scope: Freshness and evidence-quality review of current open-source DWG/DXF peer releases, branches, and recent issue reports, reconciled with existing local owners and fast tests.

sources.name: LibreDWG NEWS 0.14.1
sources.observation: NEWS identifies 0.14.1 as a beta dated 2026-07-25; release/source behavior must be pinned separately from mutable master and documentation.

sources.name: LibreDWG 0.14.1 milestone
sources.observation: Milestone page last updated 2026-10-03 showed 10 open issues and 68% completion.

sources.name: LibreDWG manual version page
sources.observation: Manual landing page identifies version 0.13.4, so it is not automatically version-synchronized with 0.14.1 NEWS.

sources.name: ACadSharp releases and compatibility matrix
sources.observation: Latest listed tag is v3.7.1 (2026-08-18); operation/version matrix is a project declaration, not evidence for every feature on every artifact.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1184
sources.observation: Report names v3.6.35 and v3.6.51 and describes stored ShadePlotDPI=0 leading to layout loss on its DWG route.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1234
sources.observation: Report names v3.6.51, v3.7.1, and a specific master SHA for SummaryInfo length loss; same-codec readback reportedly fails to reveal the missing property.

sources.name: ACadSharp issue #1195
sources.observation: DXF omission report for 3DSOLID/REGION explicitly names ACadSharp 3.4.9; it does not establish current release behavior or the result of an unmerged writer proposal.

sources.name: ezdxf 1.4.5 documentation
sources.observation: Declares ASCII/Binary DXF read/write for R12 and R2000-R2018, plus legacy read-only upgrade routes; no DWG codec claim.

sources.name: IxMilia.Dxf 0.8.4 changelog and compatibility declaration
sources.observation: 0.8.4 changelog records a front-clipping-plane fix; README declares DXF scope through R2014 with explicit entity exceptions and writer-acceptance caveats.

local_cross_checks.result: Existing generated ASCII/Binary controls include DPI=0 with non-Custom resolution for both LAYOUT and PLOTSETTINGS, tolerant readback, metadata retention, and a following geometry sentinel. No duplicate test was recommended.

SummaryInfo authoring remains unqualified; generic DWG encoded-string boundary tests are not SummaryInfo semantics. ACIS modeler routes remain staged by entity, carrier, owner/AcDs association, independent reopen, and semantic acceptance.

plan_delta: Separate peer source revision, released package/executable identity, and documentation/spec revision in composed comparison receipts.
Check issue-reported version/profile against the exact peer artifact; mark mismatches historical signals rather than current runtime results.
Retain source-object identity and loss disposition across each read/write/reopen/semantic stage.
Keep fast local tests and implementation order unchanged; no peer runtime or external fixture per slice.
